context_for_next_testing_agent: Milestone notifications feature fully tested. Two notification types: 1) milestone_proximity (within 3 referrals of next milestone) shows 'Almost There!' with 'Invite Friends' button, 2) milestone_claimable (milestone reached but not claimed) shows 'Reward Ready!' with 'Claim Now!' button. Alert appears 8-13 seconds after login. Use sessionStorage.setItem('kona-promo-shown', 'true') to suppress promo popups during testing.
